card.name: Linking words before effect verbs
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "that", "also", "generally" or "may" that come right after a noun like drugs, conditions or symptoms and just before a verb describing an effect. Seen in warning sections of drug labels.

modes.label: Relative "that" after drugs or conditions
modes.description: The word "that" follows "drugs" or "conditions" and introduces what those drugs or conditions do.
modes.example: Persons who are using drugs<< that>> suppress the immune system are more susceptible to

modes.label: Adverb or modal after symptoms
modes.description: A word like "generally", "also" or "may" sits between a subject and its verb.
modes.example: Signs and symptoms<< generally>> improve after reduction in dose or discontinuation

card.plain: It fires on the small word that links a group of drugs or symptoms to the verb saying what they do.
